The average price per square meter in Athens generally ranges from **€2,500 to €3,500/m²** for standard residential properties, though prices vary significantly depending on the neighborhood and apartment size.[[1]](https://www.globalpropertyguide.com/europe/greece/square-meter-prices)[[2]](https://www.indomio.gr/en/agora-akiniton/)[[3]](https://pmrealestate.gr/blog/athens-property-prices-2024)[[4]](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/emmanouil-agrios-993ba617_athens-real-estate-intelligence-map-2026-activity-7501546664076152832-oLX_)

### Average Prices by Region (2026)

- **Athens City Center:** €2,500 – €2,800/m² (with historic and upscale spots like Kolonaki or Plaka reaching €4,900 – €6,000+/m²)
- **Southern Suburbs / Athens Riviera** (Glyfada, Voula, Vouliagmeni): €4,000 – €7,000+/m² (luxury waterfront properties can exceed €10,000/m²)
- **Northern Suburbs** (Kifisia, Ekali, Paleo Psychiko): €3,500 – €4,800+/m²
- **Western Suburbs** (Peristeri and surrounding areas): €2,200 – €2,900/m²
- **Piraeus:** €2,800 – €3,200/m²[[1]](https://beta-globe.com/real-estate-prices-athens/)[[2]](https://www.globalpropertyguide.com/europe/greece/square-meter-prices)[[3]](https://www.engelvoelkers.com/gr/en/resources/buying-property-in-athens-is-it-still-worth-investing-)[[4]](https://pmrealestate.gr/blog/athens-property-prices-2024)[[5]](https://www.vonpollgreece.com/en/blog/1353/what-shapes-greece-real-estate-prices-in-2026)[[6]](https://www.xe.gr/en/property/real-estate-market-trends-in-greece)[[7]](https://istasyaproperty.com/en/greece-real-estate-trends-2026/)[[8]](https://dkg-development.com/business-in-greece/piraeus-real-estate)

### Key Market Trends

- **Size Pricing Paradox:** Smaller apartments (under 80 sq.m.) command a higher average price per square meter (around €3,080/m²) compared to larger units over 121 sq.m. (~€3,086/m² or lower depending on the district) due to high demand for short-term rentals and entry-level housing.
- **Growth Pace:** Overall price growth has cooled to a steadier 4% to 5% year-over-year rate following the sharp post-pandemic surges.[[1]](https://www.xe.gr/en/property/real-estate-market-trends-in-greece)[[2]](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/emmanouil-agrios-993ba617_athens-real-estate-intelligence-map-2026-activity-7501546664076152832-oLX_)[[3]](https://www.globalpropertyguide.com/europe/greece/square-meter-prices)[[4]](https://istasyaproperty.com/en/greece-real-estate-trends-2026/)
